about_the_game:
Drifter Star: Evolution — From Stardust to Galactic Sovereign

Embark on an epic journey through space and time in this unique cosmic evolution game.

Core Gameplay:

  • Start as a tiny asteroid and grow by consuming cosmic matter

  • Evolve through collisions and devouring, progressing through planet, star, black hole forms

  • Make crucial choices at each evolution stage to shape your unique celestial body

Key Features:
▶ Dynamic Growth System - Real-time consumption and instant evolution
▶ Strategic Evolution Tree - Choose different paths: Ice Fortress, Life Cradle, or War Planet
▶ Risk & Opportunity - Avoid larger celestial bodies while seizing growth chances
▶ Stunning Cosmic Landscapes - Experience scale shifts from asteroid belts to galaxy clusters

Your Mission:
✓ Carefully select devouring targets
✓ Develop long-term evolution strategies
✓ Balance risks and rewards
✓ Rise through the cosmic food chain

Ready to dominate the cosmos? Begin your devouring evolution journey and uncover the universe's ultimate secrets!
